content.title: Astrana Health (NASDAQ:ASTH) Beats Q3 Sales Expectations
content.summary: Healthcare services company Astrana Health reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 99.7% year on year to $956 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.14 billion at the midpoint came in 2.2% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.01 per share was 97.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
